newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE SEES VOLUME BOOST FROM NEW TRADE SYSTEM.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE SEES VOLUME BOOST FROM NEW TRADE SYSTEM.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Friday that it expects 10 percent trade volume growth after it changes its morning price fix system next week.
From next Thursday or Friday, the bourse will allow both selling and buying of unlimited amounts of shares during the reopening hour of trade after the morning price fix.
Until now shares at a set volume could either be bought or sold at the morning price fix.
"I see volume growing at least 10 percent," Aivars Slokenbergs, bourse vice-president, told a news conference.
"The surplus side of buying or selling will alternate authomatically whenever the orders can be fulfilled," said Armins Kalninsh, trading and settlement department head.
Slokenbergs said that the hour to trade after the reopening trade hour will not be extended in August.
The bourse has embarked on a trading modernisation programme, aimed at reaching a point where at least a group of the most liquid stocks can be traded continuously.
